report: Blinded convergence shadow re-review of PR #2030 (issue #2020, Batch 5 brand-cased DevFlow->PRFlow prose sweep) at HEAD 1f70d8b. Reviewed the full origin/main..HEAD delta (22 files: CLAUDE.md, README.md, install.sh, docs/**, scripts/**, lib/** non-test comments/log-strings, plus frozen-bucket reclassifications in lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json and a .changeset file). Engine Phases 0-4.3 executed; roster fanned out to 5 agents (has_new_types false -> no type-design-analyzer; pr-test-analyzer dispatched because lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json is a test-path change). Independent structural verification: (1) lib/test/lint-brand-devflow-sweep.py runs green (exit 0, audited 1145/1145 files) -- the authoritative bidirectional fail-closed completeness gate; (2) every in-scope file was drained from pending_sweep_baseline (0 remain) and every remaining in-scope brand-cased DevFlow occurrence maps to a registered frozen bucket entry; (3) all frozen/test-pinned/selector literals correctly kept: DEVFLOW_* env vars, devflow_* functions, devflow.yml filename, .pr_devflow_provenance selector, SHIM_MARKER 'Generated by DevFlow', DevFlow-Reviewer App name, label:PRFlow,DevFlow OR-selector, DevFlow Weekly Report heading, and install.sh withheld-tier log literals ('carries no DevFlow signature', 'the file is not DevFlow's'); (4) internal consistency confirmed -- the previously-fixed install.sh comment at line 1053 quoting 'carries no DevFlow signature' still matches the frozen log literal it emits at line 1069, and the prune_stale_devflow_workflows 'PRFlow signature' comment describes the review_dedupe grep, not a DevFlow literal. No renamed comment contradicts an adjacent unrenamed code literal. No runtime behaviour changes. Only one non-blocking Suggestion (latent, pre-existing property of broad frozen-context substring matching; pr-test-analyzer explicitly states no action needed for this PR and it cannot produce a false green for the current green tree).

phase3_findings.description: Frozen-occurrence `context` matching is line-substring-broad: a short/generic context (e.g. 'Migrate from DevFlow', 'DevFlow-Reviewer', 'label:PRFlow,DevFlow') freezes every DevFlow on any line containing that substring, so a future new brand-cased occurrence landing on such a line could be silently exempted from the AC3 new-occurrence guard. Inherent design property, not introduced by this PR; no false green possible for the current tree. No action needed for this PR; keep contexts as specific as the line allows.

per_reviewer_assessment.prflow:code-reviewer: Clean. Verified frozen literals preserved, test-pinned strings preserved, no comment/code contradiction, baseline drain consistent. No findings >= confidence 80.
per_reviewer_assessment.prflow:silent-failure-hunter: Clean. Traced every hunk touching an error path, guard, or selector literal; no fail-closed->fail-open regression, no swallowed errors. Provenance plumbing and shim-marker guard unchanged. No findings.
per_reviewer_assessment.prflow:comment-analyzer: Clean. Diff edits comments in place (no new blocks), so prevention-only length standard raises nothing. Specifically hunted for renamed-comment-vs-unrenamed-literal contradictions and found none. No documented_falsehood/comment_drift. No findings.
per_reviewer_assessment.prflow:pr-test-analyzer: One non-blocking Suggestion (latent broad-context freeze property). Confirmed drain-without-handling and stale-frozen-context are both caught by the fail-closed lint; frozen bucket is the correct mechanism. No Critical/Important gaps.

Ran the sweep lint green, confirmed test-pinned installer strings survive unswept and swept siblings are not pinned, spot-checked frozen reclassifications, changeset present. No issues.
